title: The breaking-bump gate (LCLI-632) must require a minor bump or a breaking marker when a release adds or raises an error-tier finding
description: From the 0.14.0 release ruling (opum-doc seq 665, relayed by team-lead 2026-10-13); NOT part of that release. LCLI-632's breaking-bump gate (scripts/check-breaking-bump.mjs) reads the CHANGELOG heading, not behaviour, which is why a patch 0.13.1 passed while shipping two new error-tier lore check findings (LCLI-702 agent-profile-pin-capacity, LCLI-712 duplicate-adr-ordinal) that can turn a clean bundle red. When a release introduces a new error-tier finding id, or raises an existing one to error, the gate must require at least a minor bump or a breaking marker. Design of how the gate learns the finding set (source diff versus a declared list) is opum-doc's to rule; raise it before building.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A release whose finding registry gains a new error-tier id, built against a patch bump with no breaking marker, is refused by the gate with a remedy naming the id
The same new error-tier id at a minor bump passes the gate
A finding raised from warning to error is refused at a patch bump the same way, and a warning-tier addition is not refused
release.yml runs the extended check on every dispatch like the existing breaking-bump job
